fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and criticism of Miami municipal actions under Mayor Everest George Sewell, including discussion of taxpayer impacts, bond/finance concerns, and a city ordinance involving acquisition and mortgaging of property (including reference to the Roney Plaza hotel). Coverage also reviews the record of state's attorney Vernon Hawthorne in several prominent cases (including the Zangara case) and discusses local racing at Hialeah, along with nightlife and entertainment items and advertisements.
